mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET content = #{content}, rating = #{rating}, is_spoiler = #{isSpoiler}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
mapper.select: SELECT review_id as reviewId, user_id as userId, animation_id as animationId, rating, content, like_count as likeCount, is_spoiler as isSpoiler, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM reviews WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET report_count = report_count + 1, is_hidden = CASE WHEN report_count + 1 >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE is_hidden END WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
